question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

The patient was conscious after the surgary.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"surgary"** is incorrectly spelt; the correct spelling is** "surgery."** (शल्य चिकित्सा)

 
 
• **Example: **The patient was conscious after the **surgery.**
 
 
 
• **"Surgery" **refers to a medical procedure involving an incision with instruments; it is performed to repair damage or arrest disease in a living body. (शल्य चिकित्सा)
 
 
• **Example: **She had to undergo **surgery** to remove her appendix.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is** 'surgery.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Patient **(मरीज): A person receiving or registered to receive medical treatment.

 
 
• **Example:** The patient was recovering well after the operation.
 
 
 
• **Conscious **(सचेत): Aware of and responding to one's surroundings; awake.
 
 
• **Example: **He was fully conscious during the entire procedure.
 
 
 
• **After** (बाद): In the time following (an event or another period of time).
 
 
• **Example:** We went out for dinner after the movie.
